tui.small.approval.allow_verb.note: The live approval card's verb, shown after the tool name so the row reads 'allow <tool>'. The message IS the verb: it has zero ICU arguments and is appended to a Rich Text row that then supplies the target, so the value's TRAILING SPACE is load-bearing — do not trim it. No maxCells: the card's own scored ladder sheds clauses by width rather than capping this word. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.copy.code_count.note: The code-block tally in a /copy message hint, e.g. '3 code' appended after the line count and joined with ' · '. The pre-extraction f-string used the bare word 'code' at EVERY count including 1 ('1 code'), so this key deliberately has NO plural branch — adding one would change bytes. {shown} is str(code_count), a raw digit string: a number/plural '#' slot would group 1200 as '1,200' where the original printed '1200'. No maxCells: the hint is right-aligned and the label truncates beside it. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.copy.quote_count.note: The quote-block tally in a /copy message hint, e.g. '2 quote' appended after the line count and joined with ' · '. The pre-extraction f-string used the bare word 'quote' at EVERY count including 1 ('1 quote'), so this key deliberately has NO plural branch — adding one would change bytes. {shown} is str(quote_count), a raw digit string: a number/plural '#' slot would group 1200 as '1,200' where the original printed '1200'. No maxCells: the hint is right-aligned and the label truncates beside it. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.draft.attachment_count.note: The parenthesised image tally appended to a recovered draft's notice row, e.g. '(1 image)' / '(3 images)'. ICU plural on the raw count: zero never reaches this key (the caller guards `if images`), so the other branch is the only one that renders in practice and one covers the singular. The parentheses are INSIDE the branches, and {shown} carries the digit: the pre-extraction code used the bare integer (f'{images} image...'), so {shown} must be str(images) — a {images, number}/`#` slot would group 1200 as '1,200' and break byte identity. No maxCells: the notice row wraps/clips through the transcript block's own budget. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.model_picker.window_position.note: The catalogue-position summary in the /model footer, e.g. '14 of 300' — the visible window's size against the full match count, drawn only when the window cannot show the whole list. {shown} and {total} are RAW digit strings, exactly as the pre-extraction f-string printed them; both are typed as plain args (not {x, number}/plural) because grouping them into '1,200 of 3,000' would be a visible change the catalogue slice must not smuggle in, matching tui.analytics.totals.calls_meta's raw-count convention. The footer joins this with ' · ' separators in code, so the value carries no separator. No maxCells: the footer is fitted by the picker's clause-fit pass. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.picker.showing_prefix.note: The word opening the 'showing 1–9 of 42' window counter shared by the ask and move pickers, drawn as a separate Rich Text fragment so the numerals can carry a brighter style than the grammar. The TRAILING SPACE is load-bearing — it is the only separator before the span fragment — so do not trim it. The full phrase is assembled in code from this prefix, the span, tui.small.picker.of_separator and the total, preserving each fragment's style. No maxCells: the ask picker drops this word first when the row cannot fit. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.picker.of_separator.note: The ' of ' between the visible span and the total in the 'showing 1–9 of 42' window counter shared by the ask and move pickers, drawn as a separate Rich Text fragment so the numerals can carry a brighter style than the grammar. BOTH spaces are load-bearing — they are the only separators around the span/total fragments — so do not trim them. No maxCells: the ask picker drops the 'showing' prefix first when the row cannot fit, never this separator. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.session.resume_hint.note: Printed AFTER the TUI has released the terminal, so it lands in the user's scrollback where the command can be copied. {hint} is a ready-made 'lop --resume <id>' command string, kept verbatim (a command is syntax, never translated). The LEADING and TRAILING newlines are part of the value and are load-bearing: the leading one detaches the block from the frame above it and the trailing one is followed by print()'s own newline, so the caller must keep a plain print(). The em dash is literal text, not ICU syntax. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.spend.channel_not_itemised.note: The note appended to a spend row whose channel is the residual 'other' bucket, so the row's money figure is not itemised per channel. 'itemised' is the British spelling used across this panel; keep it. Zero ICU arguments, one line; the row's note budget is applied by the caller. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.timing.no_samples.note: The dim cell drawn in the timing table where a row has no bar because no sample was recorded (timing is None, empty, or the scale is degenerate). It must NOT read as a measured zero: an absent sample is not a fast one, which is why the words are drawn and the zero in parentheses is the literal sample count rather than a measurement — the whole string is one fixed value with no ICU arguments and no substitution. 'samples' is the plural noun for the table's unit; do not pluralise a count into it. No maxCells. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.aside.title.note: The name of the off-the-record aside card, drawn first in the card's title row in foreground ink. One short word naming the surface, not a sentence; the row truncates with an ellipsis at narrow widths. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.aside.off_the_record.note: The contract stated beside the aside card's title: exchanges here are NOT added to the chat history. The TWO LEADING SPACES are load-bearing — this fragment is appended to the same Rich Text row as the title, so the spaces are the only gap between them — do not trim. The em dash is literal text. The one deliberate exception (forking a settled exchange into the chat) is a deliberate user act, which is why the clause says nothing HERE joins the chat. The row truncates with an ellipsis. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.aside.superseded.note: Drawn dim after an aside answer that was cancelled (superseded by a newer question), so the reader knows the text above is not the live answer. The caller prefixes the card's two-space answer indent, which is layout, not copy. Parentheses are part of the marker; one short fragment, never a sentence. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.subagents.title.note: The header word of the subagent roster panel, naming the direct child subagents listed below it. One plural noun; the header row is no-wrap and truncates with an ellipsis, and the scope suffix and hotkey hint that may follow are separate fragments. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.subagents.of_scope.note: The scope suffix appended to the subagent header when drilled into one child: 'Subagents of <label>', so the reader knows these rows are that child's children, not the top-level roster. {scope} is the already-truncated selected label (model-authored, kept verbatim). The LEADING SPACE is load-bearing — it is the only break within the sentence and borrows no other separator — do not trim it. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.ask_queue.waiting_clause.note: The '<N> waiting' clause of the SOC (Space-Optimised Copy) of compact_headline. This is the emergency copy used when the full headline does not fit in the bar's width: it carries NO noun (never 'question'/'questions'), because the clause is dropped whole, not re-worded, when space runs out, and a noun here would be a THIRD count of the same thing the full headline states. '{shown}' is the RAW count as digits, never grouped or pluralised, so it prints '1', '11' and '1200' exactly as the pre-extraction f-string did. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.ask_queue.timed_out_clause.note: The '<N> timed out' clause of compact_headline, joined to waiting_clause with ' · ' in code. No noun by design (see waiting_clause): the clause is a whole unit that the bar drops or keeps, and a bare count reads correctly beside the full headline's noun-bearing sentence. '{shown}' is the raw digit string, never grouped or pluralised. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.ask_queue.urgent_clause.note: The '<N> urgent' clause stating URGENCY IN WORDS rather than only as the amber glyph ray (design round 2, D13): colour is not a channel a reader without colour has. '{shown}' is the raw digit string, never grouped or pluralised, matching the sibling clauses. It is appended to a mixed clause with ' · ' in code so the half-counts stay a prefix. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.ask_queue.question_waiting.note: The bar/header count in the chip register, e.g. '2 questions waiting', carried as an ICU PLURAL singular/plural pair so the noun agrees with the count where the pre-extraction code wrote 'question' or 'questions' by hand. 'count' is the same number as '{shown}' and exists ONLY to SELECT the branch: '{shown}' is a separate RAW digit string, so the rendered number is never re-grouped or re-formatted ('1200' stays '1200', not '1,200'). Both halves carry the same value at the call site; a locale may reorder or rephrase the sentence but must keep both arguments. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.ask_queue.question_timed_out.note: The '<N> questions timed out' clause of queue_headline, the chip register's word for the moved-on half (the list header says 'moved on' instead — see drawer_headline). ICU plural on 'count' selects 'question'/'questions'; '{shown}' is the raw digit string and must not be grouped. The two arguments are the same at the call site. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.copy_picker.title.note: The /copy picker card's title row, drawn first in label ink. One short phrase naming the surface and the key action, not a sentence; it is a fixed value with zero ICU arguments. It shares the literal that the card's own width measurement also reads, so the two cannot disagree. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.copy_picker.from_line.role: copy picker preview header position marker
tui.small.copy_picker.from_line.note: The preview pane's position marker appended to the header once the pane is scrolled: ' · from line 3'. The LEADING ' · ' and its spaces are load-bearing — this fragment is appended to the same Rich Text row as the line count, so the separator is the only gap between them; do not trim. '{line}' is a RAW digit string (offset + 1), never grouped or formatted as a number, so a long document's marker reads 'from line 1200'. The header claims no position while unscrolled, so this key is only resolved when offset > 0. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.copy_picker.more_lines.note: The '… N more lines' overflow marker on the preview's last drawn row, stating how many SOURCE lines sit below the pane. ICU plural on 'count' gives the singular '… 1 more line' the pre-extraction code wrote by hand; '{shown}' is the RAW digit string and is deliberately NOT the same formatting path as 'count' (no grouping, no locale number formatting), so 1200 prints '1200'. The leading ellipsis '…' and the space after it are part of the value. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.link_picker.title.note: The /links picker card's title row, drawn first in foreground ink: one short phrase naming the surface and the key action, not a sentence, with zero ICU arguments. The card's own width measurement reads the same literal via this key, so the title and the timing that reserves its row cannot disagree. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.info_panel.last_heartbeat_ago.role: info panel session row heartbeat age clause
tui.small.info_panel.last_heartbeat_ago.note: The 'last heartbeat <age> ago' clause on a wedged session row in /info, stating how long since that runtime last reported. {age} is the already-formatted duration string from format_duration (e.g. '4m'), passed verbatim; this key adds only the surrounding words, so the digit formatting the pre-extraction f-string printed is unchanged. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.info_panel.needs_pending.role: info panel session row pending clause
tui.small.info_panel.needs_pending.note: The 'needs <pending>' clause on a session row with work waiting. {pending} is the record's own pending description string, passed verbatim (it already carries its noun and count), so this key is only the leading verb and the single space before it; do not add a noun or a number here. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.info_panel.busy_word.role: info panel session row busy state word
tui.small.info_panel.busy_word.note: The single word 'busy' closing a live session row's meta in /info. It is suppressed on wedged and leaving rows by the caller (their words already cover the state), so this key must stay the bare unqualified word with no punctuation or trailing space; the row joins clauses with ' · ' itself. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.info_panel.deeper_below_depth.role: info panel subagent tree depth overflow marker
tui.small.info_panel.deeper_below_depth.note: The '  +N deeper (below depth D)' summary row under the /info subagent tree, counting nodes hidden below the drawn depth cap anywhere in the tree. The TWO LEADING SPACES are load-bearing — they are the row's base indent, written because the row is a section summary attached to no parent row — do not trim. {deeper} and {depth} are RAW digit strings, never grouped, so 1200 stays '1200' exactly as the pre-extraction f-string printed it. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.subagent_view.row_name.role: subagent page title row surface name
tui.small.subagent_view.row_name.note: The word 'Subagent' opening the subagent page's title row, naming the surface; the child's label follows after a ' · ' seam the caller appends separately, so this key is the bare singular noun with no trailing space or punctuation. The same key paints both the swept-job row and the normal title row, so the two cannot drift onto two spellings. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.subagent_view.no_longer_on_led.note: The status phrase on the title row of a subagent page whose job the ledger has swept: the run's outcome is no longer knowable, so the row carries no glyph, clock or count, only this phrase after the label. Bare fragment, no punctuation; the caller supplies the two-space gap before it. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.wake_panel.wakes_title.note: The header word of the wake half of the wake panel band, naming the scheduled wakes listed below it. One plural noun, no trailing space; the caller appends the ' · ' seam and the scheduled count as separate fragments in their own ink. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.wake_panel.monitors_title.note: The header word of the monitor half of the wake panel band, naming the armed monitors listed below it. One plural noun, no trailing space; the caller appends the ' · ' seam and the armed/attention count as separate fragments in their own ink. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.wake_panel.monitors_need_atten.role: wake panel monitors broken-count header clause
tui.small.wake_panel.monitors_need_atten.note: The '<broken> of <total> need(s) attention' clause in the monitor section header when some armed monitors are broken. ICU plural on 'count' selects needs/need exactly as the pre-extraction hand-written verb choice did ('1 of 5 needs', '3 of 5 need'); {shown} and {total} are RAW digit strings, never grouped, so 1200 stays '1200'. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.wake_panel.monitors_armed.role: wake panel monitors armed-count header clause
tui.small.wake_panel.monitors_armed.note: The '<N> monitor(s) armed' clause in the monitor section header when no armed monitor is broken. ICU plural on 'count' gives the singular '1 monitor armed' the pre-extraction code wrote by hand; {shown} is the RAW digit string, never grouped, so 1200 stays '1200'. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.org_chart_view.team_heading.role: org chart page title team heading
tui.small.org_chart_view.team_heading.note: The opening fragment of the org chart page's title row, e.g. 'team org', in bold foreground ink. {charted} is the charted team's display name from the root node's label, kept verbatim (a name, never translated). The following fragments (' · org chart', the zoom tier) are appended as separate fragments in quieter ink, so this value carries no trailing separator. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.org_chart_view.chart_suffix.role: org chart page title chart suffix
tui.small.org_chart_view.chart_suffix.note: The ' · org chart' fragment after the team heading on the org chart page's title row, naming the view. The leading space-dot-space seam is INSIDE the value and load-bearing: it is the only separator between the heading and this fragment. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.org_chart_view.zoom_clause.role: org chart page title zoom clause
tui.small.org_chart_view.zoom_clause.note: The ' · zoom: <tier>' fragment on the org chart page's title row, always stated so an auto-collapsed small terminal explains itself. {tier} is one of outline/standard/detailed from the tier table, kept verbatim. The leading seam is inside the value. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.org_chart_view.expanded_suffix.role: org chart page title expanded suffix
tui.small.org_chart_view.expanded_suffix.note: The ' · expanded' fragment appended to the org chart title only while expand-all is on, stating that every node is unfolded. The leading seam is inside the value and load-bearing. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.org_chart_view.manager_legend.role: org chart legend manager glyph gloss
tui.small.org_chart_view.manager_legend.note: The first entry of the org chart's legend row: the diamond glyph and the word it stands for, painted in accent ink. The glyph is part of the value because glyph and gloss are one legend entry; the remaining legend entries are scanner-blind tuple copy left for a follow-up slice. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.tool_card.search_fetch_hint.note: The closing line of an expanded search-result card, telling the operator how to get a result's full page. 'web_fetch' and 'read <url>' are tool/command syntax, kept verbatim and never translated; the capitalised 'Ask Operator' address is the pre-slice wording and is preserved exactly. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.tool_card.http_blocked.note: The danger row on a fetch card whose refusal was CLASSIFIED as a bot-block: '⚠ HTTP <status> <reason> — <clause>.' {status} and {reason} are raw interpolated strings (the numeric code and its standard reason phrase), {clause} is the shared classified sentence from block_lead with NO trailing period — the period closing the row is inside this value. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.tool_card.http_error_page.role: fetch card generic HTTP error row
tui.small.tool_card.http_error_page.note: The danger row on a fetch card for an UNSIGNED HTTP refusal: '⚠ HTTP <status> <reason> — error/block page, not page content.' It deliberately claims nothing about why the origin refused. {status} and {reason} are raw interpolated strings; the closing period is inside the value. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.tool_card.rendered_row.note: The 'Rendered: <bits>' row on a fetch card, where {bits} is the pre-joined evidence string (render method, attempt summary, line and byte counts joined with ' · ' in code). Only the 'Rendered: ' label is copy here; the bits are measurements and identifiers that stay verbatim. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.tool_card.low_quality_hint.note: The hint row on a fetch card whose extraction was sparse or JS-gated, suggesting the browser for the full page. `browser` is a tool name in backticks, kept verbatim; the em dash and wording are the pre-slice bytes. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.session_picker.all_archived.note: The notice in the session picker's results pane when every conversation is archived and only the reveal toggle offers them: 'all <N> conversation(s) are archived'. The '(s)' spelling is DELIBERATE at every count — the pre-slice f-string never pluralised, so there is no ICU plural branch. {total} is a raw digit string, never grouped, so 1200 stays '1200'. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.session_picker.no_match_filter.note: The notice in the session picker's results pane when the active filter matches nothing. It names the FILTER rather than the store, because archived rows may still exist behind the toggle. Bare sentence, no punctuation. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.session_picker.no_session.note: The preview pane's fallback when no row is selected and no filter is active: 'no session'. Two words, no punctuation; with a filter active the pane instead names the query, so this only ever describes an unfiltered empty selection. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.session_picker.type_to_filter.note: The dim placeholder in the session picker's filter row when no query has been typed, stating how the list is narrowed. It is shed before the keys when the row runs out of room. Bare phrase, no punctuation. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.session_picker.showing_prefix.note: The '   showing ' lead of the session picker's window counter ('showing 1–9 of 42'), drawn as a separate fragment so the numerals can carry their own ink. The THREE leading spaces and the trailing space are load-bearing separators; this differs from tui.small.picker.showing_prefix ('showing ') used by the ask/move pickers, which is why it is its own key. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.small.session_picker.preview_mode_ke.note: The 'ctrl+e' key label in the session picker's footer, naming the chord that toggles the preview mode whose name follows it. A key name is syntax shown to the user, kept verbatim like tui.hub_links.hint.confirm ('ctrl+y'); it is extracted because the footer paints it as user-facing copy. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.
